videos.video_subject: Lamine Yamal said he and Mbappé were the two best players in the world, then softened his stance on Messi's Ballon d'Or claim; he is a bookmaker favourite and could be the youngest winner
videos.video_script: Lamine Yamal said he and Mbappé are the two best players in the world. Weeks later, he changed his tune. In September he told L'Équipe the other twenty-nine nominees are all incredible, and said Messi fans are being reasonable. The bookmakers still rate him a favourite for the Ballon d'Or. At nineteen, he could become the youngest winner ever. Did he earn it, or is he just too confident?
